headline: Payments of $1,570,907.86 for Bond Series 2025 Requisition #6 and $276,273.46 for Facilities Opportunity Initiative Requisition #2, plus school building project updates.
summary: The meeting will cover updates on Central Falls High School, Raices Dual Language School, and other building projects. It will also include a revolving fund update, public comment, and votes on two sets of bill payments.
items: Owner's Project Manager/Ai3 Architects project updates: Central Falls High School update
Owner's Project Manager/Ai3 Architects project updates: Raices Dual Language School update
Owner's Project Manager/Ai3 Architects project updates: other projects, including abatement and demolition, retaining wall, and track and field replacement
School Building Committee Revolving Fund (potential vote): 26/27 Revolving Fund Subcommittee update
Vote on payments of outstanding bills: Bond Series 2025 Requisition #6, $1,570,907.86
Vote on payments of outstanding bills: Central Falls Facilities Opportunity Initiative Requisition #2, $276,273.46
